title: Structure Hazard Marking System

evidence.source_text: Never enter a damaged structure unless trained, equipped, and authorized.
You may find a 2 x 2 box at the entrance to indicate the condition of the structure.

nodes.text: Structure is safe for SAR with minor damage or fully collapsed

evidence.source_text: Structure is safe for Search and Rescue (SAR) with minor damage, or structure is fully collapsed.

nodes.text: Structure is significantly damaged with some safe areas

evidence.source_text: Structure is significantly damaged with some safe areas, but other areas which need to be shored up or braced.

nodes.text: Structure is unsafe and may collapse suddenly

evidence.source_text: Structure is unsafe and may collapse suddenly.
Entrance is located in direction of the arrow.

nodes.text: Mark specialist ID, time, date, and hazardous materials

evidence.source_text: This information should be found outside the upper right portion of the box: Specialist ID, Time and date of assessment, Hazardous materials identified

nodes.text: Mark structure with SAR team status

evidence.source_text: Single slash (2 long) indicates SAR Team is currently in structure conducting operations.

nodes.text: Mark structure as SAR team has left

evidence.source_text: Cross/slash (2 x 2) indicates SAR Team has left structure/area.

nodes.text: Mark details in four quadrants of cross slash

evidence.source_text: This information should be found in the four quadrants of the cross slash: Left quadrant = SAR Team ID, Upper quadrant = Time and date team left structure, Right quadrant = Personnel hazards, Lower quadrant = Number of patients still inside structure
This information should be found in the four quadrants of the cross slash.
